dropped_note: counts only; ids, names and positions of dropped elements are not written anywhere

dropped_rules.inside_sensitive_area: whole geometry within 10 m of a dropped area
dropped_rules.along_sensitive_area: >= 25 m of line / outline within 10 m of a dropped outline (public roads, railways, waterways and the aerodrome boundary exempt)
dropped_rules.on_dropped_line: whole geometry within 10 m of a dropped line (roads, waterways, passenger railways and the aerodrome boundary exempt), or a tagged node within 2 m of it
dropped_rules.along_dropped_line: >= 25 m of line / outline within 10 m of a dropped line and within 30 deg of its direction (crossings do not count; public roads NOT exempt; waterways, passenger railways and the aerodrome boundary exempt)
dropped_rules.railway_point_near_dropped: node with a railway=* tag within 30 m of any dropped feature
dropped_rules.railway_point_of_dropped_railway: railway=* node that is a vertex of a dropped railway way and of no kept railway way
dropped_rules.non_passenger_railway_near_dropped: railway way that is not a passenger line or station (service=*, non-passenger usage, disused, ...) within 100 m of a dropped line or area
dropped_rules.non_passenger_railway_connected: non-passenger railway way connected to a dropped one through spur / yard / industrial / disused track (not station sidings or crossovers)
dropped_rules.crossing_vertex: vertex that a kept way shares with a dropped line, a dropped railway way or a dropped tagged node, other than its end point: removed from the kept geometry and not listed in osm_elements.json (the way is kept)

osm_elements_check.note: every listed node is a kept tagged node, a vertex of a kept way or a member of a kept relation (counts only)
